about: One row per platform. requires = asset ids from scripts/scan.py ASSETS (a|b means either). dr = domain rating as claimed by the source, never measured here; null = unknown. verified: yes = the submission flow and the listing's link were both observed; flow = the flow was checked on the official page or by use, the link was not; no = secondhand. steps: claude = Claude does it locally; approve = Claude runs it after an explicit yes (publish, PR, upload); human = the user does it (accounts, payment, DNS, forms, email). files = repo paths whose presence means the claude: steps are done (the factory queues the row past them). see = pointer to the fact's other home instead of steps.
